fields.description: A company Bank Account in ERPNext. Its account's currency is the currency customers pay in; its bank, account name, number, IBAN and branch code are the details they are given.
fields.label: Bank Account

fields.description: What shoppers see, e.g. "US dollars (ACH transfer)"
fields.label: Label

fields.description: What the customer's bank calls the account's branch code, e.g. "BSB" or "Sort code". Left empty, it is named for the account's currency.
fields.label: Branch Code Name

fields.description: In the account's currency: what the bank takes from a transfer made from a bank in its own country. Added to the order
fields.label: Local Transfer Fee

fields.description: In the account's currency: what the bank takes from an international (Swift) transfer. Added to the order. Swift transfers are offered when the account's Bank has a SWIFT code
fields.label: Swift Transfer Fee

fields.description: Extra lines for the customer, e.g. "Please pay by ACH, not wire"
fields.label: Instructions
